rows.label: Auto Kick
rows.description: The game aims and times field goals and punts for you.

rows.label: Kick Style
rows.description: Safe takes the sure kick. Aggressive pushes for distance and misses more.

rows.label: Reaction Delay
rows.description: Milliseconds the DLL waits before it acts. Higher feels more human.

rows.label: Your DLL reads these with ms_get("auto-kick", key) from modsettings.dll.
